# VICO — Accessibility Audit (baseline)

**Date:** 2026-09-22 · **Target:** SI 5568 Part 1 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA
**Scope:** `/`, `/menu/` (primary), `/jobs/`, shared header/footer, the `/en/` mirror (generated by `scripts/build-en.py`), three PDFs, Tabit flows (third party).
**Method:** code review of every page/partial; axe-core 4.10 (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `best-practice`) run against the **live** site in Chromium; contrast computed from design tokens; pixel sampling of the hero photo under its scrim; PDF metadata inspection.

This file records the state **before** fixes. Pass/fail after fixes is tracked in [ACCESSIBILITY_CHECKLIST.md](ACCESSIBILITY_CHECKLIST.md).

Severity: **Critical** blocks a task for some users · **Serious** significant barrier / clear AA failure · **Moderate** friction or partial failure · **Minor** best practice.

---

## 1. Automated baseline (live site, axe-core)

| Page | Serious | Other | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 40 × `color-contrast` | — | 13 "incomplete" (text over images: header nav on hero) |
| `/menu/` | 62 × `color-contrast` | — | |

axe didn't flag everything below. Missing `<main>`, the skip link, carousel motion, wine-table semantics and hidden-but-focusable controls came from code review.

---

## 2. Findings

### F-01 · Serious · Colour contrast of brand text colours — WCAG 1.4.3
Evidence (computed from `ds/tokens/fig-tokens.css`):

| Pair | Ratio | Where used (all < 18.66px bold / < 24px regular → need 4.5:1) |
|---|---|---|
| sage `#67857C` on cream | **3.68** | dish/menu descriptions, `.cat__latin`, `dt`, `small`, wine list, footer meta |
| sage on white | **4.02** | cocktail descriptions |
| sage on deep-green | **3.14** | `.footer__legal` links (incl. **הצהרת נגישות**), `.signup__legal` separator |
| tomato `#EF4045` on cream | **3.50** | `.kicker`, prices (16px), `.bar__wines strong`, `a:hover` |
| tomato on pink | **3.36** | `.tonight__eyebrow` |
| white on tomato | **3.83** | **every primary button** (14–17px/800), `.dish__badge` (11px) |
| cream on tomato / tomato on cream | **3.50** | `.intro__card--home` button and text (menu) |

Files: `ds/tokens/*`, inline `<style>` in `index.html`, `menu/index.html`, `jobs/index.html`, `ds/header.css`, `ds/footer.css`.

### F-02 · Serious · Text over the hero photograph — WCAG 1.4.3
Pixel sampling of `assets/hero-1280.jpg` under `.hero__scrim` (1024px viewport): `.hero__sub` (cream, 17–22px) **2.56–2.99:1**; `.hero__title` (large) worst **2.04:1**; header nav at top **4.34:1** worst. The sub-headline sits over the white pizza dough. File: `index.html` (`.hero__scrim`).

### F-03 · Serious · Home page has no `<main>` landmark; menu H1 is outside `<main>` — 1.3.1 / 2.4.1
`index.html` has only `<section>`s between the header and footer. In `menu/index.html` the `<main>` starts *after* the intro (H1) and the category nav, and the bottom CTA is outside it. `jobs/index.html` is correct.

### F-04 · Serious · No skip link — WCAG 2.4.1 (Level A)
The first Tab stop is the logo, followed by 7 nav links and the order button. No “דלג לתוכן הראשי”. Files: all pages, `assets/header.js`.

### F-05 · Serious · Auto-moving gallery has no pause control — WCAG 2.2.2 (Level A)
`#gallery` scrolls forever via `requestAnimationFrame`. It pauses only on `mouseenter`, so keyboard and touch users can't stop it. `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected, which is good but not sufficient on its own. The hero also runs a 22s infinite "drift" animation (`.hero__media`). File: `index.html`.

### F-06 · Serious · Invisible controls stay focusable — WCAG 2.4.7 / 2.4.3
`.site-mobilebar.is-hidden` uses `opacity:0; pointer-events:none`. Its two links still take keyboard focus while invisible (on the home page, while the hero is on screen, at ≤640px). File: `ds/header.css`, `assets/header.js`.

### F-07 · Serious · Wine prices are an unstructured div grid — WCAG 1.3.1
`menu/index.html` `.wine`: the "כוס / בקבוק" column headers are `<span>`s. A screen reader hears "מוני שסק לבן 32 119" with nothing tying the numbers to glass or bottle. Empty glass cells are silent, and the currency isn't announced.

### F-08 · Moderate · Heading hierarchy on the menu — 1.3.1
Under "בירה" (H3) each beer is also an H3 ("ויינשטפן" ×2), so they look like siblings of the Wine/Cocktails/Beer sub-headings. On the home page the dish names and cocktail names are `<div>`s, so they don't show up in heading navigation.

### F-09 · Moderate · Redundant / noisy link names — 2.4.4
- Home dish cards: the link name is image alt + name + description, and the alt repeats the name, e.g. "פסטה שחורה עם פטריות ושמן כמהין פסטה שחורה פסטה טרייה שחורה…".
- Instagram grid: 6 identical links "VICO באינסטגרם" (plus the handle link), so a keyboard user presses Tab 7 times to pass one destination.
- "הזמנת מקום" is a `tel:` link, but its name doesn't say it's a phone call.
- Arrow glyphs "←" inside link text ("להזמנה ←", "פתיחה במפות ←") are read aloud as "left arrow".
- Language toggle's accessible name is "EN" (spelled out) and relies on `title`.
- 20+ `target="_blank"` links give no warning that they open a new window (advisory G201; Israeli auditors commonly expect it).

### F-10 · Moderate · Focus indication inconsistent — 2.4.7
Only `.btn` and the burger have a custom `:focus-visible`. Nav, footer, category pills, dish cards, text links and the map card rely on the browser default, which is weak on deep-green and photo backgrounds.

### F-11 · Moderate · Mobile drawer keyboard handling — 2.1.1 / 4.1.2
The burger has `aria-expanded` but no `aria-controls`. `Esc` doesn't close the drawer, and focus isn't returned when it closes. File: `assets/header.js`.

### F-12 · Moderate · Language of parts — WCAG 3.1.2 (AA)
English/Italian phrases on Hebrew pages have no `lang`: "Takeaway", "Wine Terrace", "Visit VICO", "VICO'S Friends", "Today/Tonight at VICO", "Coming soon", "Pizza · Pasta · Wine", the category Latin names (Antipasti, Dolci…), "Pasta Piccola". A Hebrew voice mispronounces them.

### F-13 · Moderate · Reflow at 200%/400% — 1.4.4 (+ 1.4.10 best practice)
- `.dish__desc` is line-clamped to 2 lines at ≤640px, so at 200% zoom text visible at 100% gets cut off.
- Menu at 400% (320×256 CSS px): the sticky header (62px), sticky category nav (~60px) and fixed mobile bar (66px) take up ~73% of the viewport height.

### F-14 · Moderate · Menu category nav state conveyed visually only — 1.3.1 / 4.1.2
The active pill (`.is-active`) is shown by colour inversion only. Nothing exposes it to assistive tech (`aria-current`).

### F-15 · Moderate · Accessibility-statement link JS-dependent; statement PDF-only
The footer (and its **הצהרת נגישות** link) is injected by `assets/footer.js`. It's a real `<a>` once JS runs (keyboard- and screen-reader-reachable), but without JS, and for text crawlers, it doesn't exist. That's why the external crawler couldn't see it. The statement exists only as a PDF. Its link also fails contrast (F-01).

### F-16 · Moderate · `aria-label` on a role-less `<div>`
`.site-mobilebar` has `aria-label="פעולות מהירות"` on a plain `div`, so the label is ignored.

### F-17 · Minor · Motion
The `.rise` fade-in, hover scale on dish/Instagram images and header transitions are all short and covered by the global `prefers-reduced-motion` rule, which already exists on all pages. OK apart from F-05.

### F-18 · Info · PDFs (not covered by this HTML audit)
All three PDFs are Google Docs exports. They are **tagged** (`/StructTreeRoot`, `/MarkInfo` present), but:
- `/Lang (en)` on Hebrew documents (all three).
- Empty or English `/Title` (statement: blank; club terms: "Member Club"; privacy: none).
- The extracted text layer shows bidi/reading-order damage: `ltd.vico.www`, `אבן עזרא ,17`, `)במבנה במתחם(`.
- The statement doesn't mention SI 5568, WCAG 2.0 or level AA, the date of the audit, or the tools/AT used.

These need a document-accessibility check (PAC 2024 / Acrobat) under SI 5568 Part 2. See the checklist.

### F-19 · Info · Third-party flows (Tabit)
Takeaway ordering (`tabitisrael.co.il`) and club signup (`customer-profile.tabit.cloud`) are outside this repo and weren't modified. They need a manual test (checklist §Third-party).

---

## 3. What already passes
- `<html lang="he" dir="rtl">` on all Hebrew pages (`lang="en" dir="ltr"` on `/en/`); unique, descriptive `<title>` per route.
- One H1 per page. H2 per section/category, H3 per dish on the menu.
- `<header>`, labelled `<nav>` ("ניווט ראשי", "קטגוריות תפריט", "ניווט תחתון"), `<footer>`.
- No positive `tabindex`, no clickable `div`/`span`; the burger is a real `<button>` with `aria-label`/`aria-expanded`.
- Decorative images use `alt=""` (hero, atmosphere, strips, cocktails); map image has a descriptive alt; logos have alt; SVG icons are `aria-hidden`.
- Dish names, descriptions and prices are real text; the category jump links point to unique IDs, and `scroll-padding-top` clears the sticky header.
- Global `prefers-reduced-motion` rule; the gallery switches to manual scrolling under reduced motion.
- No overlay/widget installed.
